instruction: Look at hard-12_seed.dxf. On this machine, launch AutoCAD 2024 from the desktop shortcut, then open `hard-12_seed.dxf`. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'louvered HVAC damper panel' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, LOUVER, OUTLINE, REFERENCE. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Use an AutoCAD rectangular ARRAY command for the repeated louver pair described below, then explode or otherwise convert the array before export so the final DXF contains direct LINE/LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, and TEXT/MTEXT entities. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (0,0)->(260,0); OUTLINE (260,0)->(260,120); OUTLINE (260,120)->(0,120); OUTLINE (0,120)->(0,0); LOUVER array from two sample lines (35,25)->(225,43) and (35,30)->(225,48) with 1 column and 7 rows, row spacing 12, yielding louver start-y pairs (25,30), (37,42), (49,54), (61,66), (73,78), (85,90), and (97,102), with each endpoint 18 mm higher than its start point; CENTER (130,0)->(130,120); CENTER (0,60)->(260,60); CUTOUT (47,24)->(83,24); CUTOUT (47,16)->(83,16); CUTOUT (177,104)->(213,104); CUTOUT (177,96)->(213,96). Required circles: HOLE center (30,30) radius 6; HOLE center (230,30) radius 6; HOLE center (30,90) radius 6; HOLE center (230,90) radius 6; HOLE center (130,60) radius 10. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (47,20) radius 4 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (83,20) radius 4 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (177,100) radius 4 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (213,100) radius 4 start 270 end 90. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H12; ANNOTATION text DAMPER PANEL. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
